scope: Original-only read-only full-mesh topology census followed by a separately owned bounded durable readback. No simplifier, candidate creation, material query, Blender, render, or method retry is authorized by this receipt.

review.original_identity: Pinned original vertices/faces/native-byte source and authenticated historical edge/component cache only. Rejected candidate artifacts are authenticated preservation, never geometry input. Occurrence-to-cache equality, exact multiplicities, source index bounds, and unused-vertex semantics are explicit.
review.topology: Reviewed consistent opposite-direction two-face adjacency; distinct global sheets and per-original-vertex corner fans; complete junction, boundary, winding, fan, sheet, and positional-alias protection; complete one-ring guard and position-class closure. Full simplicial link checks require exactly the two opposite neighbors and reject shared opposite link edges, including tetrahedra.
review.work_bounds: Free-edge degree <=128 and padded comparison work <=4e9 are admission gates; incomplete work is BLOCKED without silently dropping edges. Equality-table batches are <=8MiB. Saved face/vertex/edge component and octant distributions use their stated distinct denominators.
review.host: Fixed CPU Python -I -B workers; original base/branch and exact source/plan/log review binding; exclusive phase output; binary GO after owned Job attachment; both process and Job 6GiB, 180s, 12GiB free RAM and 2GiB free disk floors; natural empty Job, measured peaks, source stability and exact worker receipt required. Verification additionally binds and watches the completed owned census host/result and every durable manifest file before its source snapshot.
review.durable_readback: Independent chunked index/permutation/key/multiplicity and stage-mask/count/distribution replay; all eligible endpoint/protected-face constraints; bounded complete-star full-link witnesses for positive populations. Zero eligibility is accepted only with the explicit locked/protected endpoint certificate or exhaustive bounded link witnesses. No second global fan graph or historical cache is rebuilt.
review.independence: Reviewer authored verify_worker.py and its initial six synthetic tests, and independently reviewed common.py, census_core.py, worker.py, run_host.py and test_census.py. Root separately reviewed verify_worker.py and test_verify.py and reported no blocking defect; root authored the isolated-entry correction and regression. This is an aggregate receipt with that disclosed authorship boundary, not a claim of self-independent verifier review.
review.tests: Frozen focused log: 17 synthetic tests PASS in 2.672s, including pinned local protection parity, fan/sheet pinch, alias/signed-zero, tetrahedral link, unused vertices, cache and mask corruption, distributions, cancellation and isolated -I helper resolution. No actual census or data worker was executed by this reviewer.

resolved_findings: Face-stage masks were renamed fully_unlocked_interior_faces and guard_affected_interior_faces, with the endpoint-versus-face cohort caveat stated in source and plan.
The redundant comparison mask was removed so the padded equality table remains a single <=8MiB allocation.
Verification host now authenticates and watches its exact completed owned predecessor and full durable manifest before snapshot and launch.
Before any worker launch, verify_worker.py was corrected to insert its resolved evidence directory under Python -I; an isolated non-main load regression now checks exact common.py resolution.
limitations: Memory is a staged projection, not an actual measured census peak. NumPy intp sorting, SciPy float64 validation/undirected transpose and graph-label buffers are included in the conservative ledger; runtime process and Job caps remain decisive.
The 150s cooperative checks occur between bounded phases/chunks; native sort and sparse-component calls cannot be interrupted mid-call, so the outer 180s owned Job deadline is decisive.

Durable readback authenticates census fan/alias outputs and independently replays their protection closure; it does not independently regenerate those full global classifications. Positive link populations receive all-endpoint checks plus bounded full-link witnesses, not a second full link census.
A host PASS records completed bounded execution, including a worker BLOCKED outcome. No simplification safety, target reduction, visual preservation or surface-quality result is claimed.
